arg.name: ego
arg.description: the ego's YAML: default (aib's src/autoware_isaac_bridge/src/aib/config/ego.yaml: aib's Tesla Model 3, a PhysX vehicle with Autoware's sensors and vehicle interface), none (037's kinematic box) or a path to an aib ego config

arg.name: world
arg.description: worlds to preload, comma separated: world files (map/isaac/world.yaml), map directories or USD files; the first stays loaded; none: nothing

arg.name: follow
arg.description: true: with a window, no UI and a viewport chasing the ego

arg.name: render
arg.description: auto (a window on DISPLAY when set, unless ISAAC_HEADLESS=1) | window | headless

node.name: isaac_world
node.args: --port $(env ISAAC_PORT 5590) --ego $(var ego) --ego-domain $(env EGO_ROS_DOMAIN_ID 1) --world $(var world) --follow $(var follow) --render $(var render)
